title: Orchestrate audience-specific change briefs with embedded FAQ and localization pipeline
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: produce a set of audience-annotated change briefs that can be consumed both internally (ops/runbooks, sales, execs) and externally (tiered customer changelogs and localized summaries). Deliver an authoring template with embedded FAQ snippets, automatic extraction points for product managers to flag Q&A, and a lightweight localization handoff that reduces translation cycles by 40%.
milestones: 2026-02-26: Localization pipeline spec and vendor checklist finalized
2026-03-03: Internal review with Engineering & Legal (first pass)
2026-03-10: Customer-visible drafts produced for Tier 1 and Tier 2
acceptance_criteria: Single authoring template accepted by PM, Design, and Comms
Automated extraction tags present for: user-impact, rollback guidance, and FAQ entries
Localized drafts produced for es-ES and fr-FR within SLA (48h)
Signoff checklist completed by Legal, Security, and Growth
Publishing flow integrates with Console changelog UI and email digest
